decky_update_hint: Installing can take a couple of minutes
decky_problem_not_installed_body: This panel launches the Punktfunk app, which isn’t on this device yet. Install it in Desktop Mode.
decky_problem_scan_failed_body: Something went wrong while scanning — Refresh tries again.
decky_problem_outdated_body: This client is too old to find hosts on your network. Saved hosts still work.
decky_empty_body: Open Punktfunk to find and pair one.
decky_open_app_hint: Settings, adding a host by address, and browsing a host's games all live here.
decky_play_menu_hint: The ▾ beside a game's Play button lists your hosts that have it, next to Steam Link's; pick one and Play becomes Stream.
decky_host_steam_menu_hint: Press the Steam/guide button on the host
decky_host_qam_hint: Open the host's Quick Access Menu
decky_end_game_hint: Close {title} on the host, then end the stream. Unsaved progress is lost.
decky_recreate_hint: Missing the Punktfunk entry in your library, or seeing several? This puts one back and removes the rest.
decky_remove_game_shortcuts_hint: Streams started from a game's page run under a hidden entry named after that game. This removes them; each returns on its next Stream.
decky_force_stop_hint: Ends a stream that stopped responding.
decky_trust_refused: {host} is already saved under a different identity. Forget it in the Punktfunk app before trusting it again.
decky_trust_outdated: Update the Punktfunk client to use request access
decky_client_unreachable: Couldn’t reach the Punktfunk client — is it still installed?
decky_trust_no_identity: No advertised identity for this host — pair with a PIN instead.
decky_trust_open_host: {host} accepts new devices. Connecting pins its identity so later streams are silent.
decky_trust_needs_approval: {host} needs to let this device in before it can stream.
decky_trust_request_hint: Request access asks {host}’s operator to approve this device in its console or web UI. No PIN to type — this device is paired as soon as they do.
decky_pair_wrong_pin: Wrong PIN, or the host isn’t showing one. Arm pairing again and retry.
decky_pair_outdated: Update the Punktfunk client to pair from here
decky_pair_intro: Arm pairing on the host (its console or web UI), then enter the 4-digit PIN it shows.
decky_boundary_body: The plugin hit a display error — this device is fine. Reload Punktfunk from Decky's plugin list, or update the plugin.

match.n=one: {count} Steam game ready in Play menus
match.n=other: {count} Steam games ready in Play menus

decky_update_server_unreachable: Couldn’t reach the update server — are you online?
decky_update_available_both: Update available: plugin v{current} → v{latest} + client {version}.
decky_update_available_both_unknown: Update available: plugin v{current} → v{latest} + client.
decky_update_client_manual_note: The client updates outside Punktfunk on this install.
decky_update_client_outdated: Couldn’t check the client — it predates update checks. Update it once by hand.
decky_update_client_check_failed: Couldn’t check the client for updates
decky_update_dev_build: Development build — plugin updates are disabled; the client is up to date.
decky_client_updated: Client updated to the latest version.
decky_client_current: Client is already up to date.
decky_client_manual: This client updates outside Punktfunk — use the way you installed it.
decky_client_update_unreachable: Couldn’t reach the client to update it — is it still installed?
decky_client_manual_command: This client updates outside Punktfunk. Run: {command}
decky_client_update_timeout: Client update timed out — check this device and try again
decky_client_updating_slow: Updating the client — this can take a few minutes…
decky_client_update_manual: A newer client ({version}) is available — update it the way you installed it.
decky_plugin_updating: Updating the plugin to v{version} — confirm Decky’s prompt. This can take a couple of minutes.
decky_plugin_update_manual: Update the plugin from Decky → Developer → Install Plugin from URL.
decky_end_game_unresolved: Couldn't tell which game to end.
decky_trust_bad_fingerprint: Couldn’t read {host}’s identity — pair with a PIN instead.
